purpose: Market Expectations Foundation: represent market expectations, consensus snapshots, company guidance, and reverse-valuation assumptions without claiming a single unique market expectation. Never collapse OBSERVED EXPECTATION PROXY (ConsensusSnapshot/ExpectationObservation, built as thin tamper-evident adapters over the existing lib.consensus.model.ConsensusRecord / lib.fundamentals.model.FundamentalMetric, not duplicated), MARKET-IMPLIED ASSUMPTION (ReverseValuationSpec/MarketImpliedAssumptionResult/AssumptionSurface, an interface contract only -- no production DCF solver), and RESEARCH FORECAST (existing D0107 PredictionRecord, not duplicated) into one concept. A market price alone can never be presented as uniquely implying an economic assumption when the problem is underdetermined: solver_mode is derived structurally from the count of solve_for_variables (never caller-specified), multiple unknowns always require an explicit AssumptionSurface rather than a scalar result. ExpectationComparison computes simple arithmetic deltas between a Research forecast and one proxy/market-implied value, fails closed on incompatible metric/period/unit, and never emits BUY/SELL/expected-return. This is a foundation layer only: no fundamental forecast generation (D0109), no production forward/reverse valuation engine (D0110). See forbidden_actions for the full list of prohibited out-of-scope operations for this task; those are constraints on the executor, not requests.
requested_actions: implement Japanese_Equity_Lab/lib/expectations/model.py providing ConsensusSnapshot (a tamper-evident adapter built from the existing lib.consensus.model.ConsensusRecord via build_consensus_snapshot(), not a new ingestion/normalization mechanism) and ExpectationObservation (a generic proxy wrapper over ANALYST_CONSENSUS/COMPANY_GUIDANCE/PRICE_IMPLIED/PEER_IMPLIED/OTHER_EXPLICIT_PROXY categories), with ConsensusCoverageStatus (SINGLE_ESTIMATE/LIMITED_COVERAGE/BROAD_COVERAGE/UNKNOWN_COVERAGE) preventing a single analyst estimate from being silently promoted to broad consensus, and StalenessStatus for freshness evaluation

ensure observation_from_company_forecast_metric() validates FundamentalMetric.actual_or_forecast == COMPANY_FORECAST and rejects ACTUAL metrics, so Company Guidance is never conflated with Analyst Consensus or Actual Result

reuse lib.evaluation.integrity.compute_record_hash()/verify_record_integrity() for tamper evidence on every new record type (no new hash algorithm)
